summary: Tested speaker-pair batching pipeline rewrite. All 32 backend unit/integration tests passed verifying: batching logic (8 dialogues → 2 batches), multi-speaker payload format, WAV utilities, cache key consistency, utterance reconciliation, and API endpoints. Frontend ScriptEditor and AudioStudio pages load correctly with all key UI elements functional.
critical_code_review_comments: group_dialogues_by_speaker_pairs correctly batches dialogues: scans in order, starts new batch on 3rd speaker, merges identical pairs
8 dialogues with 4 characters (Rahul, Aarti, Sagar, Meera) produces exactly 2 batches: Aarti+Rahul[0,1,2,3,6,7] and Meera+Sagar[4,5]
_build_multi_speaker_payload creates correct Gemini multiSpeakerVoiceConfig with speakerVoiceConfigs array
Director notes included in payload text only when non-empty
_extract_clip_from_wav is frame-accurate: 1-second clip from 3-second source verified ±0.05s
_validate_wav rejects: size < 1000 bytes, missing RIFF header, missing WAVE marker
_reconcile_utterances merges adjacent same-speaker utterances to match expected dialogue count
compute_cache_key produces deterministic 32-char hex hashes, strips whitespace
POST /api/script/{episode_id}/generate returns job_id in scrjob_* format
GET /api/script/job/{job_id}/status returns status, total_dialogues, completed_dialogues, results
GET /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} returns valid WAV audio with RIFF/WAVE headers
